newsitem.title: LATVIA: LIEPAJA FISH CANNERY SHARES SUSPENDED.
newsitem.headline: LIEPAJA FISH CANNERY SHARES SUSPENDED.

text.p: The Riga stock exchange on Thurdsay said it has suspended trade in Liepaja fish cannery shares on reports it is close to insolvency.
"The bourse decided to suspend the company from today until the situation is clarified," a bourse spokeswoman told Reuters.
"Reports are quoting the company's accountant as saying Liepaja cannery is on the brink of bankruptcy," she added.
Liepaja Fish, a secondary list stock, was suspended shortly in May for failing timely to submit first quarter results.
Liepaja registered a first quarter profit of 10,532 lats on turnover of 397,639 lats.
The company finished 1996 with 201,037 lats losses on turnover of 1.19 million.
